title: Add dependency snapshot gate and reproducible build hash v2
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: CI build failures and cache misses traced to nondeterministic dependency resolution and subtle OS-level ordering differences for lockfile generation. This PR introduces a deterministic dependency snapshot step plus an automated gate that validates the resolved dependency graph before expensive integration runs. Key ideas: (1) a 'dep-snapshot' workflow that records the fully-resolved graph (module/version/checksum) and emits an immutable snapshot artifact; (2) a dep-graph-validator action that compares incoming PR resolution vs the canonical snapshot and blocks the job matrix when unexpected drift is detected; (3) bump to a reproducible build-hash v2 that includes ordered file lists, normalized timestamps, and canonicalized environment metadata to make cache keys stable across runners. Implementation notes: added a small Go-based validator (tools/dep-graph-validator) and a lightweight action wrapper under ci/actions, added scripts/hash-build.sh and pkg/build/hash/v2.go to compute the new build hash, and updated GitHub workflows to emit/consume the snapshot artifact. Rollout plan: enable gate as 'warning' for 3 days on the main repo, then enforce for all release/* branches; initial snapshot generated from main @2026-02-20. Related: ENG-7842 (root cause analysis), ENG-7901 (cache-variance investigation). Checklist: -- add dep-snapshot workflow (done) -- implement validator action (done) -- update build cache key logic (done) -- update docs and run a week of monitoring (done) -- communicate to SDK teams and provide migration notes (done). Backwards compatibility: existing caches still valid; build-hash v2 is additive and falls back to v1 when not present. Observability: added metrics for 'dep_snapshot_mismatch' and CI telemetry for gate rejections. Security: validator only reads lockfile/artifact metadata and runs in GH actions sandbox; no secrets exposed. Migration steps for integrators included in docs/engineering/reproducible-builds.md. Merge: squash-merged after green CI and two approvals.

release_notes: Adds a dependency snapshot artifact and a dep-graph validator gate to detect accidental drift in resolved dependency graphs; introduces build-hash v2 to improve cache reproducibility and reduce CI flakiness. Backwards compatible; provides migration guidance for SDK teams.
